about: What the launcher (csnv-launch.exe) reads from the player's CS2 files before every Play, and where it lands. CS2 is never started or touched while running: these are plain text files on disk. Search order: newest <Steam>/userdata/<account>/730/local/cfg/<cs2_file>, then the defaults in <CS2>/game/csgo/cfg/, then the default column. The launcher writes Data/config/csnv_cs2.ini, which the scripts read with GetINIFloat.

columns.cs2_file: CS2 file pattern it is read from
columns.cs2_key: binding command or convar name inside that file
columns.default: value used when the file or key is missing (CS2's own default)
columns.convert: how the CS2 value becomes the ini value
columns.used_by: hooks.id or hud.id that uses it
columns.verified: true once read from a real CS2 install and seen working in game

rows.convert: the key bound to 'buymenu' -> DirectInput scancode (launcher keymap); unknown key -> 48 (B)
preset 0 red 250,50,50 | 1 green 50,250,50 | 2 yellow 250,250,50 | 3 blue 50,50,250 | 4 cyan 50,250,250 | 5 custom = xhair_r/g/b
used when cl_crosshairusealpha is 1, else 255; clamp 0-255
arm length in UI units = size * 2, clamp 1-60
gap from centre in UI units = 4 + gap, clamp 0-40
arm thickness in UI units = max(1, round(thickness * 2))
